title: The Runestone
offer: I will raise a runestone for my mother. The stone comes from the quarry by Bergö, and the runecarver needs iron chisels from the smith. The stone is so big, it takes three crates of room!

stone.name: Stone
stone.counted: {count|a piece of the stone|{count} pieces of the stone}

steps.load_say: It is in three pieces, to fit in your boat. The carver joins them.
steps.say: The stone! The carver begins today.
The runestone stands! It says: Eirik raised this stone for Gunnvor, his good mother. And at the bottom, small: Ylva and Sigrid rowed it.

fact: Runestones were raised for loved ones, and painted in bright colours.
